# Rivera Fragrance House

> 100% Authentic Middle Eastern and Designer Fragrances at Honest Prices in the Philippines.

Rivera Fragrance House is a growing, family-run fragrance shop based in Malabon, Metro Manila, Philippines. We are dedicated to providing genuine factory-sealed perfumes with verified manufacturer batch codes. We keep our pricing fair and accessible, catering to both personal fragrance lovers and emerging perfume resellers nationwide.

## Core Offerings

- **Genuine Middle Eastern & Designer Perfumes**: Popular fragrances from Rasasi, Armaf, Fragrance World, Rayhaan, Afnan, Lattafa, Maison Alhambra, French Avenue, Khadlaj, and Zimaya.
- **Factory-Sealed Bottles**: Every unit arrives in authentic factory packaging with matching batch codes. Zero counterfeits.
- **Personal Retail & Reseller Friendly**: Single bottle orders for daily wear or flexible small-bulk packages for local perfume resellers across the Philippines.
- **Nationwide Delivery**: Express courier dispatch across Metro Manila (same-day options) and provincial delivery to Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao with heavy-duty protective bubble wrap.
- **Currency & Pricing**: Transparent Philippine Peso (PHP, ₱) pricing.
